description: MISHIT SPIN — make slices, shanks and scuffs carry realistic spin so they read as mis-hit, not just misdirected. P1 unclamps the spin-axis sideways-lean from 45 to 90 deg so a shanked/sliced kick's sidespin grows with the size of the horizontal miss (the actual 'slice' lever); P2b gives assisted passes/shots the same spin build as manual (so assisted mishits curl too); P2 lifts the spin-magnitude cap slightly. Pairs with dt270 ball.magnusRate (amplifier). Stacks on slices-scuffs-max. exe_patch.py restore reverts.

patches.name: P1. Unclamp sidespin lean 45->90 deg (sidespin scales with the horizontal miss = real slices/shanks)
P2b. Assisted-kick spin scale 50->80 (assisted passes/shots build the same spin as manual, so their mishits curl)
P2. Spin-magnitude cap 0.9->1.0 (mild overall curl/dip increase)
